purpose: Independently assess whether a preserved shifted source identity and zero conditional-minus-scope effect determine dependence or estimator-score long-run variance, and assess the algebraic feasibility of the proposed second-order continuation.

findings.finding: Four independent stationary lag-four binary chains, interleaved by time phase, preserve C_t=Y_(t-2). C and Y lie in different phases, so they are independent at the same decision time and E[Y|C=1]-E[Y]=0 even when outcome dependence at lag four is nonzero.
findings.mixing_argument: All examined transition probabilities are strictly between zero and one. Any chronological four-bit target state is reachable from any start in four steps with positive probability. The finite chain is therefore irreducible and aperiodic and has geometric dependence decay. This is not a nonmixing or periodic pathology used to evade the estimator assumptions.
findings.warranted_conclusion: The source identity and zero effect do not force an IID outcome null. The published lag-linked model remains a valid declared restricted stress case; it does not span this dependent-null variation.

findings.finding: For g(m_CY,m_C,m_Y)=m_CY/m_C-m_Y at the null point (q^2,q,q), the centered linearization is phi=(CY-q^2)/q-(C-q)-(Y-q)=(C-q)*(Y-q)/q.
findings.qualification: The score belongs to the canonical condition-versus-whole-scope ratio contrast with fully known conditions and complete eligible observations. It is not a condition-versus-complement estimator and does not assume q is externally known by the estimator. Random denominators and possible zero conditioned counts prevent treating its variance as the exact finite-sample estimator variance.

findings.finding: Point variance is (1-q)^2 for every examined rho. Odd-lag score covariances vanish; lag 2k covariance is (1-q)^2*rho^k. Their absolutely convergent sum gives long-run variance (1-q)^2*(1+rho)/(1-rho), with ratios 1/3, 1 and 3 at rho=-1/2,0,1/2.
findings.independent_method: Use the four-state stride-two pair process (A,B)->(B,Z), rather than the parent's chronological sixteen-state representation. At the null Q*phi=rho*phi, and h=phi/(1-rho) solves (I-Q)h=phi exactly. The Poisson identity 2*E[phi*h]-E[phi^2] reproduces the claimed long-run variance in all six null cases.
findings.time_scale_qualification: Interleaving the two independent score phases adds no extra factor two or four. The original-time odd-lag covariances are zero and its even-lag sum equals the stride-two result.
findings.limits: This is a population score long-run variance, not a finite-sample estimator variance ratio, standard-error measurement, bootstrap miscoverage estimate, statistical power result or actual market diagnosis.

findings.finding: At rho=0, outcomes are IID but the overlapping score values generally are not IID. Direct enumeration of three independent Bernoulli values gives Cov(phi_t^2,phi_(t+2)^2)=(1-q)^3*(1-2q)^2/q.
findings.qualification: This positive squared-score covariance at q=19/47 establishes score dependence despite zero ordinary score autocovariances. It does not change the stated score long-run variance ratio at rho zero. The final assessment correctly distinguishes IID outcomes from possibly dependent overlapping scores.

findings.finding: For r=e/(1-q), alpha=(1-beta)*r and conditional mean q+alpha*(Y_(t-2)-q)+beta*(Y_(t-4)-q), the proposed consecutive-pair masses are stationary in each independent time phase and yield effect e. Given the pair law, E[Y_(t-4)-q|Y_(t-2)]=r*(Y_(t-2)-q), so alpha+beta*r=r preserves the required lag-two pair relation.
findings.independent_check: All 18 listed q/e/beta cells have positive pair masses, strict-interior transition probabilities, exact stationary residuals, correct q marginals and target e. Every entry of the stride-two pair kernel squared is positive, directly confirming finite-state mixing for these cells.
findings.reductions: e=0 recovers the dependent-null construction; beta=0 recovers the previously implemented lag-linked transition law.
findings.limits: Only these declared algebraic cells were checked. The example beta values are not fitted nuisance estimates or universally feasible defaults. Negative-effect scenarios, arbitrary masks, shared innovations across responses/instruments, exact joint history initialization, capacity and owned runtime integration are not supplied by this check. The existing first-order solver must not be reused as though the larger history state were one binary coordinate.

parent_exact_check.qualification: Exact finite-state enumeration, not simulated calibration worlds or a runtime test suite. The six null parameter cells also occur in the 18-cell candidate grid; these are not 24 distinct parameter triples.

independent_exact_check.command_form: python -B -c <complete independent Fraction-based four-state/Poisson procedure preserved verbatim in the command record>
independent_exact_check.additional_check: Exact three-Bernoulli enumeration of squared-score dependence at rho=0 and q=19/47.

documentation_review.outcome: Accurately distinguishes unchanged point variance from changed long-run variance, IID outcomes from overlapping score dependence, algebraic feasibility from runtime implementation, and the proposal from an adopted or adequate market calibration profile.

remaining_uncertainty: The actual source's negative empirical products do not identify rho, beta or any market population law.

The long-run variance identities apply to the fully observed single-response mathematical construction. Unknown-condition, eligibility, cross-instrument and other sampled masks require their own score and joint-law analysis.
No finite-sample ratio-estimator variance, coverage, bootstrap classification error, power or N_min has been measured or proved here.
The candidate second-order law is not a production generator, approved nuisance profile or scientific acceptance rule.

A future implementation must preserve all assigned effect scenarios, real history state, exact joint initialization or a separately justified alternative, source/replay/accounting controls and retained failures.
warranted_next_action: Use this concrete dependent-null omission to design and independently test a versioned bounded second-order stress generator and its joint history initialization. Before substantive calibration, assess its actual nuisance and applicability scope rather than treating the examined beta values or one-day engineering template as fitted truth or a universal research catalog.
